purpose: fiducial final-align error budget and stall current backout timing
code_or_query:
import numpy as np
# alignment budget: coarse dead-reckoning bounded 0.15 m (E33), final visual servo to tag
# assume mast camera range 1.0-2.0 m, tag pose noise 0.02 m + 1% range
ranges = np.array([1.0,1.5,2.0])
noise = 0.02 + 0.01*ranges
print("ranges m:", ranges, "pose err m:", np.round(noise,3))
# pour needs outlet 0.15 m over bin mouth ~0.4 m => allow +/-0.1 m lateral
# visual servo creep speed 0.1 m/s, correction of 0.15 m takes 1.5 s
print("creep correct 0.15m at 0.1m/s = 1.5 s")
# stall backout: ladder motor time constant ~0.2 s, current threshold trip 0.1 s, reverse 0.5 s
print("detect 0.1s + reverse 0.5s = 0.6s stall recovery, vs thermal 300s E44")
